title: Standard form
text: Standard form is $$y'+p\left(x\right) y=q(x)$$. Move every $$y$$ term to the left side and everything else to the right.

title: Divide by $$-x$$
text: Dividing by $$-x$$ gives $$y'=-\left(\frac{3x+2}{x}\right) y-e^x$$. Then $$y'+\frac{3x+2}{x} y=-e^x$$, so $$p(x)=\frac{3x+2}{x}$$.
